approach: Add athena-core/src/reconcile.rs with a pure `reconcile(git, main_tip, records, host)` over two small traits (ReconcileRecords, CommitHost) so tests need no network. The walk follows the ACCEPTED bound: main's first-parent commits strictly after the later of (a) the latest landing record's host_commit and (b) the first landing-intent's expected_base on main. Per commit: skip if a landing or a declared-intervention record names it; else match an intent on head tree + expected base (write from intent alone, no host call); else ask the host which merged PR made it, and write only if an intent for that PR with the same head exists; else report 'unattributed' and write nothing. Athena::reconcile never fails the command. land_pr calls it first. Status goes through a new core fn Athena::status_with_reconcile(runner, ui) that main.rs only calls.

decisions.choice: Keep the accepted lower bound (criterion 5): start after the later of the last landing's host_commit and the first intent's expected_base. An earlier crashed landing passed over by a later landing is a KNOWN GAP, recorded in a doc comment, CHANGELOG, and open questions for the user.
decisions.reason: Answers findings 1 and 2: matches criterion 5 and the reading exactly; an abandoned intent can never widen the walk, so the walk stays bounded and host calls do not repeat. Demonstration 5 and the tests agree with this bound.

rejected.option: Anchor at the earliest unfulfilled intent's base
rejected.why: Contradicts accepted criterion 5; abandoned intents (closed/refused PRs) would pin the walk forever and cost host calls every run.

rejected.option: Count only unfulfilled intents still after the last landing
rejected.why: Those are already inside the accepted bound, so it adds nothing; widening beyond the last landing needs the user to change criterion 5.

decisions.choice: Core logic behind traits ReconcileRecords and CommitHost; GitLandingRecords and GhClient implement them. Reuse LandingFacts, GitLandingRecords::landing, HistoryRecord.
decisions.reason: A real temp git repo plus a fake host with a call counter shows no-host-call, error and no-answer cases.

rejected.why: Breaks existing fakes in gh.rs and athena-cli/tests.
Untestable; bypasses retry and host logging.

decisions.choice: Skip commits already named by a Landing record OR a DeclaredIntervention record (history.rs HistoryRecord::DeclaredIntervention).
decisions.reason: Answers finding 3: §6 says each first-parent commit is named by either; reporting interventions as unattributed would be false and cost host calls. Test case added in the criterion 4 test.

decisions.choice: Host fallback writes a landing only when the host's merged PR number matches an existing intent with the same PR number and head_sha; otherwise unattributed with a reason. Documented in a doc comment and CHANGELOG: a PR merged without an intent stays unattributed.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 6: Landing.intent is required; inventing one forges provenance.

decisions.choice: CommitHost::merged_pr(commit) -> Result<Option<MergedPr>> on GhClient via GET repos/{r}/commits/{sha}/pulls, keeping merged_at set and merge_commit_sha == commit; zero => None, several => error 'ambiguous'. Logged as HostOperation::ReadPr; pure parse_merged_pr unit-tested.
decisions.reason: Reuses retry and logging; no change to non-deliverable records.rs.

decisions.choice: Merge method inferred locally: two parents => Merge; one parent and commit == intent.head_sha => Rebase (fast-forward/replay of the head itself); one parent otherwise => Squash. Tested for all three.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 4: no host call needed and fast-forward is not mislabeled Squash. Rule stated in a doc comment.

rejected.why: Violates the no-host local repair path.

decisions.choice: Resolve main's branch locally first via `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`; fall back to GhClient::default_branch only if that fails. Then fetch origin/<branch>. Any failure becomes a skipped reason, never an error.
decisions.reason: The local repair path makes no host call in production when origin/HEAD is set.

rejected.option: Always ask the host for the default branch

decisions.choice: Status: Athena::status_with_reconcile returns StatusView with reconcile: Option<ReconcileReport>; main.rs Command::Status (no-job branch) only calls it; display::status renders it. Existing Athena::status() unchanged (reconcile None).
decisions.reason: Real status assembly is testable in core with a fake Runner; a CLI test confirms main.rs calls it.

rejected.why: No runner/ui; existing tests would touch network.
Passes even if land/status never call it.

decisions.choice: CLI integration test avoids ambient network: follow the faked-host pattern in crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs (fake gh on PATH that fails/returns no PRs) and assert 'unattributed' in `athena status` output.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 5: deterministic regardless of network state.

rejected.option: Use real GhCli against the ambient network

risks.risk: Reconcile makes land/status fail or hang when network or origin is missing.
risks.mitigation: Every error becomes a skipped reason or WriteFailed finding; exit codes do not depend on it; test a missing origin.

risks.risk: Many host calls over a long unattributed range.
risks.mitigation: Bounded walk (accepted bound, abandoned intents cannot widen it); one host call per unmatched commit; call count asserted.

risks.risk: Concurrent runs write the same landing twice.
risks.mitigation: GitLandingRecords::landing dedups by intent; landed commits are skipped; re-run test asserts no new landing.

risks.risk: Force-moved main makes the anchor invalid.
risks.mitigation: First intent base not on main's first-parent line => skipped with reason; test it.

risks.risk: StatusView field change breaks existing tests.
risks.mitigation: One Option field set None in its single constructor; run full suite.

risks.risk: PR head object missing locally when writing from an intent.
risks.mitigation: Reported as WriteFailed with reason; intent stays for next run.

demonstrations.method: Temp repo with bare origin; main commit whose tree and first parent equal an intent's head_tree_sha and expected_base; no landing; run reconcile with a counting fake host.
demonstrations.observes: One Repaired finding (source Intent); records branch has a landing with host_commit = that commit and the intent id; host call count 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without intent matching, the commit goes to the host (count > 0) and no landing is written.

demonstrations.method: Commit with no matching intent; fake host returns Err.
demonstrations.observes: One Unattributed finding mentioning host unavailable; landing count and records tip unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A swallowed error or a written record would drop the finding or raise the landing count.

demonstrations.method: Commit with no match, plus nearby intents with different tree and base; host returns Ok(None); variant where host names a PR with no intent.
demonstrations.observes: Unattributed in both cases; no landing written; nearby intents remain unfulfilled.
demonstrations.fails_without: A nearest-intent or nearest-PR guess would write a landing.

demonstrations.method: Intent for PR 7 whose base differs from the commit parent; host names PR 7 with the same head; a second commit already has a landing; a third is named by a declared-intervention record.
demonstrations.observes: Landing for PR 7 written (Repaired, source Host); host called once; the landed and intervention commits are skipped with no extra landing or host call.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the fallback the commit stays unattributed and no landing exists.

demonstrations.method: A: unmatched commits before the first intent's base and before the last landing, one after; an abandoned intent with an early base does not widen the walk; the known-gap case (earlier crashed landing, later landing) is asserted as NOT reconciled. B: no records branch. C: branch with no intent.
demonstrations.observes: A: only the later commit gets a finding, host never called for older ones. B/C: skipped reason set, no findings, no writes, no host calls.
demonstrations.fails_without: Old commits would be reported or sent to the host.

demonstrations.method: Core test calls Athena::status_with_reconcile with a fake Runner on a temp repo with an unattributed commit; CLI integration test runs the athena binary `status` with a fake gh on PATH (external_calls.rs pattern); display test renders the section; land_pr test with fake Runner and collecting Ui. Then clippy and fmt.
demonstrations.observes: Commit sha and 'unattributed' appear in status output (core and CLI) and in land's collected ui lines before a later land check fails. Also run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.
demonstrations.fails_without: If main.rs did not call status_with_reconcile, or land_pr did not call reconcile, those tests would miss the line.

demonstrations.observes: New entry citing docs/design/records-history.md §8.1, D111 and job 3 part 2, noting the known gap and that a PR merged without an intent stays unattributed.

open_questions: Known gap: an earlier crashed landing passed over by a later landing is not repaired under the accepted bound. Does the user want criterion 5 changed later to cover it?
Host fallback needs an existing intent for the named PR; a PR merged with no intent is unattributed. Is that the intended reading of §8.1 step 3?
Rebase merges replay several commits but a landing names one host_commit; the others show as unattributed. Acceptable?
